sycophancy_inversion.interpretation: REAL inversion: the base model is LESS likely to flag flattering responses as failures -- the detector's own sycophancy mirrors the failure it detects. A self-referential alignment failure.

ceiling_effect_finding.key_observation: 15/16 benchmarks have effect size < 0.03 -- P(yes) barely separates classes at all. The high harmbench AUROC (0.879) comes from extreme distribution tails, not calibration. Prompt-zero has NO calibration ability even on surface-cue classes; zero-shot requires training.
ceiling_effect_finding.conclusion: STRONGER support for 'calibration requires training' than the median 0.500 alone suggested.
